Akcea, a Subsidiary of Ionis Pharmaceuticals
paragraphs: We are a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery, development and commercialization of clinically differentiated medicines for children and adults living with rare disorders. We are advancing a robust and diversified pipeline of transformative medicines as part of our mission to provide access to best-in-class treatments for patients with unmet medical needs. Our strategy is to leverage our scientific expertise and global commercial infrastructure to optimize value for our patients and other stakeholders.

We have a diversified therapeutic portfolio that includes several commercial products and product candidates in various stages of development, including discovery, research and clinical stages, focused on the development of new treatments for multiple therapeutic areas for rare diseases relating to neurology and metabolism. The disclosure below summarizes the status of our significant commercial products and clinical-stage programs as of the date of this report, including those with our strategic partners:

o SephienceTM (sepiapterin) – Sephience is our product for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients with phenylketonuria, or PKU, a rare, inherited metabolic disease, characterized by the body's inability to break down an essential amino acid called phenylalanine, or Phe, which can result in neurological and other symptoms. Through its novel dual mechanism of action, Sephience is able to effectively reduce blood Phe levels and has the potential to treat a broad range of PKU patients. Sephience is approved in the United States, European Economic Area, or EEA, Japan and additional geographies.

o Global DMD Franchise – We have two products, TranslarnaTM (ataluren) and Emflaza® (deflazacort), for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, or DMD, a rare, life-threatening disorder. While Translarna previously had conditional approval in the EEA, in March 2025, the European Commission, or EC, adopted the negative opinion of the Committee of Medicinal Products for Human Use, or CHMP, of the European Medicines Agency, or EMA, to not renew the conditional marketing authorization of Translarna for the treatment of nonsense mutation Duchenne muscular dystrophy, or nmDMD. However, the EC indicated that individual countries within the European Union, or EU, can leverage Articles 117(3) and 5(1) of the EU Directive 2001/83 to allow continued commercial use of Translarna. Translarna has marketing authorization in additional geographies outside of the EEA, though the EC adoption of the CHMP negative opinion may affect future reauthorizations. Emflaza is approved in the United States for the treatment of DMD in patients two years and older.

o UpstazaTM (eladocagene exuparvovec) / KebilidiTM (eladocagene exuparvovec-tneq) – Upstaza, a gene therapy for the treatment of Aromatic L-Amino Decarboxylase, or AADC, deficiency, a rare central nervous system, or CNS, disorder is approved for the treatment of AADC deficiency for patients 18 months and older within the EEA and the United Kingdom. This gene therapy is approved and marketed with the brand name Kebilidi in the United States.

Tegsedi has received marketing authorization in the United States, EU, and Brazil for the treatment of stage 1 or stage 2 polyneuropathy in adult patients with hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis, or hATTR amyloidosis. Waylivra is approved in Brazil for the treatment of familial chylomicronemia syndrome, or FCS, and familial partial lipodystrophy, or FPL. Waylivra has also received marketing authorization in the EU for the treatment of FCS

o Evrysdi® (risdiplam) – Evrysdi, a treatment for spinal muscular atrophy, or SMA, was approved by the FDA for the treatment of SMA in adults and children of all ages and by the EC for the treatment of 5q SMA in patients of all ages with a clinical diagnosis of SMA Type 1, Type 2 or Type 3 or with one to four SMN2 copies. Evrysdi has also received marketing authorization for the treatment of SMA in over 100 countries. Evrysdi is a product of our SMA program and our collaboration with F. Hoffman-La Roche Ltd. and Hoffman-La Roche Inc., which we refer to collectively as Roche, and the Spinal Muscular Atrophy Foundation, or SMA Foundation.

o Splicing Platform – In addition to our SMA program, our splicing platform also includes votoplam, which is being developed for the treatment of Huntington's disease, or HD. We initiated a Phase 2 study of votoplam for the treatment of HD in the first quarter of 2022, which consisted of an initial 12-week placebo-controlled phase focused on safety, pharmacology and pharmacodynamic effects followed by a nine-month placebo-controlled phase focused on votoplam biomarker effect. In September 2024, the FDA granted Fast Track designation to the votoplam program for the treatment of HD. In November 2024, we entered into a License and Collaboration Agreement with Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation, or Novartis, relating to our votoplam program, or the Novartis Agreement, which included related molecules. While Novartis has taken over responsibility for further development of the votoplam program, we continue to collaborate with Novartis on next steps for votoplam. In May 2025, we announced that the Phase 2 study of votoplam met its primary endpoints of blood HTT lowering and safety. The results on the full study population are consistent with the previously reported evidence of dose-dependent HTT lowering, favorable safety profile and early signals of dose-dependent clinical effect at 12 months in Stage 2 patients. In addition, at 24 months of treatment, there were continued trends of dose-dependent favorable clinical effect relative to a propensity-matched natural history cohort as well as dose-dependent neurofilament light protein, or NfL, lowering. In the fourth quarter of 2025, an End-of-Phase 2 meeting was held with FDA, and we reached alignment on design of a global Phase 3 clinical trial of votoplam, which we expect that Novartis will initiate in the first half of 2026. This trial could serve as the confirmatory study in the context of Accelerated Approval, or as a registration trial. We also expect to have results from the Phase 2 PIVOT-HD extension study of votoplam in the first half of 2026, once all participants cross the 24-month time point.

o Inflammation and Ferroptosis Platform – Our inflammation and ferroptosis platform consists of small molecules that target key enzymes that regulate oxidative stress and inflammatory pathways central to the pathology of a number of CNS and non-CNS diseases. The most advanced molecule in our inflammation and ferroptosis platform is vatiquinone. We announced topline results from a registration-directed Phase 3 trial of vatiquinone in children and young adults with Friedreich's ataxia, or FA, called MOVE-FA, in May 2023. While the trial did not meet its primary endpoint, vatiquinone treatment did demonstrate significant benefit on key disease subscales, including the upright stability subscale, as well as on other disease relevant endpoints. In the first quarter of 2024, we met with the FDA, who expressed willingness to review a new drug application, or NDA, for vatiquinone for the treatment of FA, based on the MOVE-FA trial as well as data from the ongoing open label extension, or OLE, study following the MOVE-FA trial, potentially allowing for the submission of an NDA in late 2024. In October 2024, we announced that the pre-specified endpoint for two different FA long-term extension studies was met, with statistically significant evidence of durable treatment benefit on disease progression. In December 2024, we submitted an NDA to the FDA for vatiquinone for the treatment of children and adults living with FA. In August 2025, the FDA issued a complete response letter related to the NDA stating that substantial evidence of efficacy was not demonstrated for vatiquinone and that an additional adequate and well-controlled study would be needed to support NDA resubmission. We met with the FDA in the fourth quarter of 2025 to discuss the vatiquinone development program. FDA suggested an additional study be conducted to support NDA resubmission. FDA

stated in the meeting minutes that this study could be an open label study with a natural history control group. We plan to meet with FDA in the second quarter of 2026 to discuss the design of this new study.

o We continue to invest in our pre-clinical product pipeline by committing resources to research and development programs to provide access to best-in-class treatments for patients who have an unmet medical need. Our pre-clinical efforts are focused on two scientific platforms: splicing and inflammation and ferroptosis, two areas of science where PTC has significant expertise.

Sephience is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients with PKU. Sephience has a novel dual mechanism of action. First, it is a natural precursor of the enzymatic co-factor BH4, a critical co-factor for phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH), the enzyme affected in PKU. Sephience is able to serve as a more bioavailable source of intracellular BH4 than by administering BH4 itself. The second mechanism of action is Sephience's ability to serve as an independent chaperone itself, stabilizing enzyme morphology and enhancing enzyme function. Through this dual mechanism of action, Sephience is able to effectively reduce blood Phe levels and has the potential to treat a broad range of PKU patients, including those with the most severe, non-BH4 responsive mutations.

PKU is a rare, inherited metabolic disease, characterized by the body's inability to break down Phe, an essential amino acid, which can result in neurological and other symptoms. If left untreated or poorly managed, Phe can build up to harmful levels in the body. This causes severe and irreversible disabilities, such as permanent intellectual disability, seizures, delayed development, memory loss, and behavioral and emotional problems. Newborns with PKU initially do not have any symptoms, but symptoms are usually progressive, and damage caused by toxic levels of Phe in the first few years of life is irreversible. Diagnosis of PKU usually takes place during newborn screening programs. There are an estimated 58,000 people living with PKU globally.

In June 2025, Sephience was granted marketing authorization by the EC for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU within the EEA. In July 2025, Sephience was approved by the FDA for the treatment of pediatric and adult patients living with PKU in the United States age one month and above. In December 2025, Sephience was approved by the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare, or MHLW, for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU in Japan, where the label includes individuals of all ages and the full spectrum of disease severity. In February 2026, Sephience was approved by ANVISA, the Brazilian health regulatory authority, for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU in Brazil. Sephience is also approved in additional geographies.

We are a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery, development and commercialization of clinically differentiated medicines for children and adults living with rare disorders. We are advancing a robust and diversified pipeline of transformative medicines as part of our mission to provide access to best-in-class treatments for patients with unmet medical needs. Our strategy is to leverage our scientific expertise and global commercial infrastructure to optimize value for our patients and other stakeholders. We believe that this allows us to maximize value for all of our stakeholders. We have developed Sephience™ (sepiapterin), a product for the treatment of phenylketonuria, or PKU, a rare inherited metabolic disease characterized by the body's inability to break down an essential amino acid called phenylalanine, and which can result in neurological and other symptoms. In June 2025, Sephience was granted marketing authorization by the European Commission, or EC, for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU within the European Economic

Area, or EEA. In July 2025, Sephience was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, or FDA, for the treatment of pediatric and adult patients living with PKU in the United States age one month and above. In December 2025, Sephience was approved by the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare, or MHLW, for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU. In February 2026, Sephience was approved by ANVISA, the Brazilian health regulatory authority, for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU in Brazil. Sephience is also approved in additional geographies. During the year ended December 31, 2025, we recognized $111.2 million in net product revenues for Sephience.

We have two products, Translarna™ (ataluren) and Emflaza® (deflazacort), for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, or DMD, a rare, life threatening disorder. While Translarna previously had conditional approval in the EEA, in March 2025, the European Commission, or EC, adopted the negative opinion of the Committee of Medicinal Products for Human Use, or CHMP, of the European Medicines Agency, or EMA, to not renew the conditional marketing authorization of Translarna for the treatment of nmDMD. However, the EC indicated that individual countries within the European Union, or EU, can leverage Articles 117(3) and 5(1) of the EU Directive 2001/83 to allow continued commercial use of Translarna. Translarna has marketing authorization in additional geographies outside of the EEA, though the EC adoption of the CHMP negative opinion and the withdrawal of the Translarna NDA in the United States may affect future reauthorizations. During the year ended December 31, 2025, we recognized $235.3 million in net product revenues for Translarna. Emflaza is approved in the United States for the treatment of DMD in patients two years and older. During the year ended December 31, 2025, we recognized $146.4 million in net product revenues for Emflaza.

Each country, including each member state of the EEA, has its own pricing and reimbursement regulations. In order to commence commercial sale of product pursuant to our Sephience marketing authorization in any particular country in the EEA, we must finalize pricing and reimbursement negotiations with the applicable government body in such country. As a result, our commercial launch will continue to be on a country-by-country basis. We also have made, and expect to continue to make, product available under early access programs, or EAP programs, or similar styled programs both in countries in the EEA and other territories. Our ability to negotiate, secure and maintain reimbursement for product under commercial and EAP programs can be subject to challenge in any particular country and can also be affected by political, economic and regulatory developments in such country.

Translarna is an investigational new drug in the United States. During the first quarter of 2017, we filed an NDA for Translarna for the treatment of nmDMD over protest with the FDA. In October 2017, the Office of Drug Evaluation I of the FDA issued a complete response letter for the NDA, stating that it was unable to approve the application in its current form. In response, we filed a formal dispute resolution request with the Office of New Drugs of the FDA. In February 2018, the Office of New Drugs of the FDA denied our appeal of the complete response letter. In its response, the Office of New Drugs recommended a possible path forward for our ataluren NDA submission based on the accelerated approval pathway. We followed the FDA's recommendation and collected, using newer technologies via procedures and methods that we designed in a new study, Study 045, and announced the results of Study 045 in February 2021. Study 045 did not meet its pre-specified primary endpoint. In June 2022, we announced top-line results from the placebo-controlled trial of Study 041, which was our 18 months, placebo-controlled trial, followed by an 18 months open label extension, of Translarna in the treatment of ambulatory patients with nmDMD aged five years or older. Following this announcement, we submitted a meeting request to the FDA to gain clarity on the regulatory pathway for a potential re-submission of an NDA for Translarna. The FDA provided initial written feedback that Study 041 does not provide substantial evidence of effectiveness to support NDA re-submission. We held a Type C meeting with the FDA in the fourth quarter of 2023 to discuss the totality of Translarna data. Based on feedback from the FDA, we re-submitted the NDA in July 2024, based on the results from Study 041 and from our international drug registry study for nmDMD patients receiving Translarna. In October 2024, the FDA accepted for review the resubmission of the NDA for Translarna for the treatment of nmDMD. Following feedback from FDA at the end of January 2026, we decided to withdraw the NDA resubmission for Translarna. Further development of Translarna for the treatment of nmDMD in the United States is not planned.

With respect to Emflaza, we have previously relied on Emflaza's seven-year marketing exclusivity period in the United States for its approved indications under the provisions of the Orphan Drug Act of 1983, or the Orphan Drug Act, when commercializing Emflaza for the treatment of DMD in patients five years and older, which expired in February 2024. With the expiration of this orphan drug exclusivity, we have seen an increase in competition from generics, which has, and we expect will continue to have, a negative impact on Emflaza net product revenue. Emflaza's orphan drug

exclusivity related to the treatment of DMD in patients two years of age to less than five expires in June 2026. See "Item 1. Business-Government Regulation" for further discussion with respect to marketing protection we rely on.

Upstaza/Kebilidi is a gene therapy for the treatment of Aromatic L Amino Decarboxylase, or AADC, deficiency, a rare central nervous system, or CNS, disorder arising from reductions in the enzyme AADC that results from mutations in the dopa decarboxylase gene. In July 2022, the EC approved Upstaza for the treatment of AADC deficiency for patients 18 months and older within the EEA. In November 2022, the Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency approved Upstaza for the treatment of AADC deficiency for patients 18 months and older within the United Kingdom. In November 2024, the FDA granted accelerated approval of our gene therapy for the treatment of children and adults with AADC deficiency, which is marketed with the brand name Kebilidi in the United States. We are obligated to complete certain post-marketing requirements in connection with the FDA's approval, including clinical safety studies.

We hold the rights for the commercialization of Tegsedi and Waylivra for the treatment of rare diseases in countries in Latin America and the Caribbean pursuant to a Collaboration and License Agreement, or the Tegsedi-Waylivra Agreement, dated August 1, 2018, by and between us and Akcea Therapeutics, Inc., or Akcea, a subsidiary of Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. In August 2021, ANVISA, the Brazilian health regulatory authority, approved Waylivra as the first treatment for familial chylomicronemia syndrome, or FCS, in Brazil. In December 2022, ANVISA approved Waylivra for the treatment of familial partial lipodystrophy, or FPL. Waylivra has also received marketing authorization in the EU for the treatment of FCS.

Evrysdi has also received marketing authorization for the treatment of SMA in over 100 countries. In May 2022, the FDA approved a label expansion for Evrysdi to include infants under two months old with SMA. In August 2023, the EC approved an extension of the Evrysdi marketing authorization to include infants under two months old in the EU.

paragraphs: 本公司為一間全球性生物製藥公司，專注於為患有罕見疾病的兒童及成人開發臨牀差異化的藥物。本公司正推動一項強而有力且多元的創新藥物研發管道，以實現為有未滿足醫療需求之患者提供最佳治療方案的使命。本公司策略為運用科學專業知識與全球商業基礎設施，以優化對患者及其他利害關係人的價值。
本公司擁有多元化的治療產品組合，包含多項已上市產品與處於不同開發階段的產品候選藥物，包括發現、研究與臨牀階段，專注於開發多種治療領域的創新治療方案，用以治療與神經學及代謝相關的罕見疾病。以下披露內容總結了截至本報告日，本公司重要上市產品與臨牀階段計畫的狀態，包括與戰略合作夥伴相關的產品：

o SephienceTM (sepiapterin) – Sephience 是本公司用以治療患有苯酮尿症（phenylketonuria，簡稱 PKU），一種罕見且遺傳性代謝疾病，特徵為身體無法分解一種必需胺基酸稱為苯丙胺酸（phenylalanine，簡稱 Phe），可能導致神經系統及其他症狀的藥物。透過其創新雙重作用機制，Sephience 能有效降低血液中的 Phe 濃度，並有潛力治療廣泛的 PKU 患者。Sephience 已獲美國、歐洲經濟區（European Economic Area，簡稱 EEA）、日本及其它地區核准。

o Global DMD Franchise – 本公司擁有兩項產品，TranslarnaTM (ataluren) 與 Emflaza® (deflazacort)，用以治療杜氏肌肉營養不良症（Duchenne muscular dystrophy，簡稱 DMD），一種罕見且致命的疾病。雖然 Translarna 過去在 EEA 獲得條件性核准，但在 2025 年 3 月，歐盟委員會（European Commission，簡稱 EC）採納了歐洲藥物管理局（European Medicines Agency，簡稱 EMA）的藥物產品委員會（Committee of Medicinal Products for Human Use，簡稱 CHMP）的負面意見，不續予 Translarna 對於 nonsense mutation Duchenne muscular dystrophy（簡稱 nmDMD）的條件性上市許可。然而，EC 表示，歐盟內的個別國家可依 EU 指令 2001/83 的第 117(3) 和 5(1) 條款，允許繼續商業使用 Translarna。Translarna 在 EEA 以外的其他地區也擁有上市許可，不過 EC 採納 CHMP 負面意見可能影響未來重新核准。Emflaza 已獲美國核准，用以治療年齡兩歲以上之 DMD 患者。

o UpstazaTM (eladocagene exuparvovec) / KebilidiTM (eladocagene exuparvovec-tneq) – Upstaza 是一種基因治療藥物，用以治療芳香族 L-胺基酸脫羧酶（Aromatic L-Amino Decarboxylase，簡稱 AADC）缺乏症，一種罕見的中樞神經系統（central nervous system，簡稱 CNS）疾病，已核准用於治療年齡 18 個月以上之 AADC 缺乏症患者，於 EEA 與英國。此基因治療藥物在美國以品牌名稱 Kebilidi 授予核准與行銷。

根據本公司與 Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 旗下子公司之合作與授權協議，Tegsedi 已獲美國、歐盟與巴西核准，用以治療成人患有遺傳性轉鐵蛋白沉積症（hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis，簡稱 hATTR amyloidosis）之第一期或第二期多發性神經病變。Waylivra 已獲巴西核准，用以治療家族性乳糜微粒血癥綜合症（familial chylomicronemia syndrome，簡稱 FCS）與家族性部分脂肪萎縮症（familial partial lipodystrophy，簡稱 FPL）。Waylivra 也已獲歐盟核准，用以治療 FCS。

o Evrysdi® (risdiplam) – Evrysdi 是一種治療脊髓肌肉萎縮症（spinal muscular atrophy，簡稱 SMA）的藥物，已獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准，用以治療所有年齡層的 SMA 患者，並獲歐盟委員會（EC）核准，用以治療 5q SMA 患者，年齡層為所有年齡，且臨牀診斷為 SMA 類型 1、2 或 3，或具有 1 至 4 個 SMN2 基因複製體。Evrysdi 也已獲核准，用以治療 SMA 患者於超過 100 個國家。Evrysdi 是本公司 SMA 研發計畫的產品，並與 F. Hoffman-La Roche Ltd. 及 Hoffman-La Roche Inc.（我們合稱為 Roche）以及脊髓肌肉萎縮症基金會（Spinal Muscular Atrophy Foundation，簡稱 SMA Foundation）合作開發。

o Splicing Platform – 除了本公司 SMA 研發計畫，我們的剪接平台也包含 votoplam，正在開發用以治療亨丁頓氏症（Huntington's disease，簡稱 HD）。我們於 2022 年第一季啟動了 votoplam 的第二期臨牀試驗，用以治療 HD，該試驗包含一個 12 週的安慰劑對照期，重點在於安全性、藥物動力學與藥物動態效應，隨後為一個 9 個月的安慰劑對照期，重點在於 votoplam 的生物標記效應。2024 年 9 月，美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）授予 votoplam 程式對 HD 治療的快速通道（Fast Track）資格。2024 年 11 月，我們與 Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation（簡稱 Novartis）簽訂了關於 votoplam 程式（簡稱 Novartis 協議）的授權與合作協議，包含相關分子。雖然 Novartis 已接管 votoplam 程式進一步開發的責任，我們仍與 Novartis 合作進行 votoplam 的下一步計畫。2025 年 5 月，我們宣佈 votoplam 的第二期試驗達成其主要終點，即血液中 HTT 濃度降低與安全性。針對完整試驗族羣的結果與先前報告的 HTT 濃度降低、安全性良好及 12 個月時階段 2 患者中劑量依賴性臨牀效果的早期跡象一致。此外，在治療 24 個月時，觀察到劑量依賴性臨牀效果的持續趨勢，相對於具有相似特徵的自然病程族羣，以及劑量依賴性神經絲輕鏈蛋白（neurofilament light protein，簡稱 NfL）降低。2025 年第四季，與 FDA 進行了第二期試驗結束會議，並達成設計全球第三期臨牀試驗的共識，預計 Novartis 將於 2026 年第一季啟動此試驗。此試驗可能作為加速核准（Accelerated Approval）的確認試驗，或作為註冊試驗。我們也預期在 2026 年第一季獲得 votoplam 的第二期 PIVOT-HD 延伸試驗結果，當所有參與者跨越 24 個月的時間點。

o 炎症與鐵死亡平台 – 我們的炎症與鐵死亡平台包含小分子，這些小分子針對調節氧化壓力與炎症路徑的關鍵酵素，這些路徑與多種大腦神經系統與非大腦神經系統疾病的病理機制有關。我們炎症與鐵死亡平台中最進展的分子為 vatiquinone。我們於 2023 年 5 月宣佈，針對患有弗裏德賴希共濟失調症（FA）的兒童與年輕成人，進行註冊導向的第三期臨牀試驗（MOVE-FA）的初步結果。雖然該試驗未達成其主要終點，但 vatiquinone 治療在關鍵疾病次尺度（包括站立穩定次尺度）及其他與疾病相關的終點上，顯示出顯著的效益。我們於 2024 年第一季與美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）會面，FDA 表示願意審查 vatiquinone 的新藥申請（NDA），用以治療 FA，基於 MOVE-FA 試驗以及持續進行的開放標籤延長試驗（OLE）的數據，可能允許於 2024 年年底提交 NDA。我們於 2024 年 10 月宣佈，兩個不同 FA 長期延長試驗的預設終點已達成，並顯示出統計上顯著的治療效益，且此效益具有持續性。我們於 2024 年 12 月向 FDA 提交 vatiquinone 的 NDA，用以治療患有 FA 的兒童與成人。我們於 2025 年 8 月收到 FDA 發出的完整回應信，指出 vatiquinone 未顯示出足夠的療效證據，並需要進行另一項足夠且嚴謹控制的試驗以支持 NDA 重新提交。我們於 2025 年第四季與 FDA 會面，討論 vatiquinone 的開發計畫。FDA 建議進行另一項試驗以支持 NDA 重新提交。FDA 在會談記錄中表示，此試驗可以是開放標籤試驗，並以自然病程為控制組。我們預計於 2026 年第二季與 FDA 會面，討論此新試驗的設計。

o 我們持續投資於我們的前期臨牀產品管道，透過投入資源至研究與開發計畫，以提供有未滿足醫療需求的患者取得最佳治療方案。我們的前期臨牀工作聚焦於兩個科學平台：剪接與炎症與鐵死亡，這兩個領域是 PTC 具有顯著專業知識的科學領域。

Sephience 用於治療患有苯酮酸尿症（PKU）的成人與兒童。Sephience 具有獨特的雙重作用機制。首先，它是酶催化輔因子 BH4 的天然前驅物質，BH4 是苯丙氨酸氫化酶（PAH）的關鍵輔因子，PAH 是 PKU 中受影響的酵素。Sephience 能作為比直接給予 BH4 更具生物可用性的細胞內 BH4 源頭。第二種作用機制是 Sephience 能作為獨立的載體蛋白，穩定酵素結構並提升酵素功能。透過這種雙重作用機制，Sephience 能有效降低血液中的苯丙胺酸（Phe）濃度，並有潛力治療廣泛的 PKU 患者，包括那些具有最嚴重、對 BH4 不反應的突變型患者。

PKU 是一種罕見的遺傳性代謝疾病，特徵為身體無法分解苯丙胺酸（Phe），一種必需胺基酸，這可能導致神經系統及其他症狀。若未治療或管理不善，Phe 可在體內累積至有害水平。這會導致嚴重且不可逆的障礙，例如永久性智能障礙、癲癇、發展遲緩、記憶喪失以及行為與情緒問題。新生兒患有 PKU 時通常沒有症狀，但症狀通常是漸進性的，而第一年內 Phe 毒性水平造成的損害是不可逆的。PKU 的診斷通常在新生兒篩檢計畫中進行。全球估計有約 58,000 名患者患有 PKU。

In June 2025, Sephience was granted marketing authorization by the EC for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU within the EEA. In July 2025, Sephience was approved by the FDA for the treatment of pediatric and adult patients living with PKU in the United States age one month and above. In December 2025, Sephience was approved by the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare, or MHLW, for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU in Japan, where the label includes individuals of all ages and the full spectrum of disease severity. In February 2026, Sephience was approved by ANVISA, the Brazilian health regulatory authority, for the treatment of children and adults living with PKU in Brazil. Sephience is also approved in additional geographies.

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析旨在提供與評估本公司財務狀況及營運成果相關的重要資訊，包括對營運現金流及來自外部資源之現金流數額與確定性的評估，以便投資人能從管理階層的觀點更深入瞭解本公司。以下關於本公司財務狀況與營運成果之討論應與本公司財務報表及財務報表附註一併閱讀，財務報表附註載於本10-K年度報告之其他部分。本討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及重大風險與不確定性。由於許多因素，例如本10-K年度報告第一部分第1A項風險因素所列者，本公司實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所預期者有重大差異。

本公司為一全球性生物製藥公司，致力於為患有罕見疾病的兒童及成人開發臨牀區分性藥物。我們正在推進一項強而多元的創新藥物開發管道，作為我們提供未滿足醫療需求患者最佳治療方案之使命的一部分。我們的策略是運用我們的科學專業知識與全球商業基礎設施，以為患者及其他利害關係人創造價值。我們相信此策略可為所有利害關係人創造最大價值。我們擁有多元的治療藥物組合，包括多項已上市產品與處於不同開發階段的產品候選藥物，包括臨牀階段、前期臨牀階段及研究與發現階段，專注於開發多種治療領域之新治療方案，針對罕見疾病相關神經學與代謝學領域。

我們已開發出Sephience™（sepiapterin），一種用於治療苯酮尿症（phenylketonuria，簡稱PKU）的產品，PKU是一種罕見的遺傳性代謝疾病，特徵為身體無法分解一種稱為苯基alanine的必需胺基酸，可能導致神經系統及其他症狀。2025年6月，Sephience獲歐洲委員會（European Commission，簡稱EC）核准上市，用於治療居住於歐洲經濟區（European Economic Area，簡稱EEA）內患有PKU的兒童及成人。

2025年7月，Sephience獲美國食品藥物管理局（U.S. Food and Drug Administration，簡稱FDA）核准上市，用於治療美國年齡滿一個月以上的患有PKU的兒童及成人患者。2025年12月，Sephience獲日本厚生勞動省（Japanese Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare，簡稱MHLW）核准上市，用於治療患有PKU的兒童及成人。2026年2月，Sephience獲巴西健康監管機構ANVISA核准上市，用於治療巴西患有PKU的兒童及成人。Sephience亦已核准上市於其他地區。在2025年12月31日財務年度內，本公司確認Sephience之淨產品收入為1.112億美元。

本公司有兩項產品，Translarna™ (ataluren) 與 Emflaza® (deflazacort)，用於治療杜氏肌營養不良症，或稱 DMD，為一種罕見且危及生命的疾病。雖然 Translarna 過去在 EEA 有條件批准，但在 2025 年 3 月，歐盟委員會，或稱 EC，採納了歐洲藥物管理局，或稱 EMA，藥物產品委員會，或稱 CHMP 的負面意見，不續予 Translarna 用於 nmDMD 治療的條件性上市許可。然而，EC 表示，歐盟內的個別國家可依 EU Directive 2001/83 的第 117(3) 與第 5(1) 條，允許繼續商業使用 Translarna。Translarna 在 EEA 以外的其他地理區域也有上市許可，不過 EC 採納 CHMP 負面意見與美國撤回 Translarna NDA 可能影響未來重新許可。在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結業年度，本公司確認 Translarna 的淨產品收入為 2.353 億美元。Emflaza 在美國已核准用於治療年齡兩歲以上之 DMD 患者。在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結業年度，本公司確認 Emflaza 的淨產品收入為 1.464 億美元。

每個國家，包括 EEA 的每個成員國，均有其自身的價格與給付規範。為在 EEA 內任何特定國家根據 Sephience 的上市許可開始商業銷售產品，本公司必須與該國相關政府機構完成價格與給付談判。因此，本公司商業發售將持續以國家為單位進行。本公司亦已提供，並預期將持續提供，產品於早期使用計畫，或稱 EAP 計畫，或類似計畫，於 EEA 內國家及其他地區。本公司在商業與 EAP 計畫下協議、取得並維持產品給付的能力，可能在任何特定國家受到挑戰，也可能受到該國政治、經濟與法規發展的影響。

Translarna 在美國為一研究中新藥。在 2017 年第一季，本公司向 FDA 提交 Translarna 的 NDA，用於 nmDMD 治療，並提出異議。在 2017 年 10 月，FDA 藥物評估一室發出完整回應信，表示無法以現狀核准申請。作為回應，本公司向 FDA 新藥辦公室提出正式爭議解決請求。在 2018 年 2 月，FDA 新藥辦公室拒絕本公司對完整回應信的上訴。在回應中，FDA 新藥辦公室建議本公司可依加速核准途徑，提交 ataluren 的 NDA。本公司遵循 FDA 建議，使用較新技術，透過本公司設計的新研究程序與方法，進行 Study 045，並於 2021 年 2 月公佈 Study 045 結果。Study 045 未達其預設的主要終點。在 2022 年 6 月，本公司公佈 Study 041 的初步結果，為本公司 18 個月的安慰劑對照試驗，後續為 18 個月的開放標籤延長試驗，用於 Translarna 對 nmDMD 年齡五歲以上之步行患者的治療。此後，本公司提交會議請求至 FDA，以獲得潛在重新提交 NDA 的監管途徑澄清。FDA 提供初步書面意見，表示 Study 041 未提供足夠的療效證據支持 NDA 重新提交。本公司於 2023 年第四季與 FDA 進行 Type C 會議，討論 Translarna 數據總體。根據 FDA 反饋，本公司於 2024 年 7 月重新提交 NDA，基於 Study 041 結果與國際藥物登記研究結果。在 2024 年 10 月，FDA 接受 Translarna nmDMD 治療 NDA 重新提交的審查。根據 2026 年 1 月底 FDA 的反饋，本公司決定撤回 Translarna 的 NDA 重新提交。美國 Translarna 對 nmDMD 的進一步開發計畫已無。
關於 Emflaza，本公司過去依賴 Emflaza 在美國核准適應症下，根據 1983 年《孤兒藥條例》的七年的市場獨佔期，進行商業化，用於治療年齡五歲以上之 DMD 患者，該獨佔期於 2024 年 2 月屆滿。隨著此孤兒藥獨佔期屆滿，本公司已見到來自仿製藥的競爭增加，這已，且預期將持續對 Emflaza 的淨產品收入產生負面影響。Emflaza 的孤兒藥
與治療 DMD 在兩歲至五歲以下病患相關的獨佔權於 2026 年 6 月到期。有關我們所倚靠的市場保護措施，請參閱「第 1 項業務－政府規範」。

Upstaza/Kebilidi 是用來治療芳香族 L 氨基酸脫羧酶，或 AADC，缺乏症的基因治療藥物，此為一種罕見的中樞神經系統，或 CNS，疾病，因 dopa 脫羧酶基因的突變導致 AADC 酶減少所致。2022 年 7 月，歐盟委員會批准 Upstaza 用來治療 18 個月以上病患的 AADC 缺乏症，適用於 EEA 地區。2022 年 11 月，藥物及醫療產品監管局批准 Upstaza 用來治療 18 個月以上病患的 AADC 缺乏症，適用於英國。2024 年 11 月，美國食品藥物管理局授予我們的基因治療藥物加速批准，用來治療患有 AADC 缺乏症的兒童及成人，此藥物在美國以 Kebilidi 品牌銷售。我們必須完成與美國食品藥物管理局批准相關的某些上市後要求，包括臨牀安全性研究。

我們持有根據 2018 年 8 月 1 日與 Akcea Therapeutics, Inc.，或 Akcea，為 Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 之子公司所簽訂的協議，或稱為 Tegsedi-Waylivra 協議，於拉丁美洲及加勒比地區國家商業化 Tegsedi 及 Waylivra 用來治療罕見疾病的權利。Tegsedi 已於美國、歐盟及巴西獲准上市，用來治療成人患者之 stage 1 或 stage 2 多發性神經病變，為 hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis，或 hATTR amyloidosis。2021 年 8 月，巴西健康監管機構 ANVISA 批准 Waylivra 為巴西首個治療家族性乳糜微粒血癥，或 FCS 的藥物。2022 年 12 月，ANVISA 批准 Waylivra 用來治療家族性部分脂肪異常症，或 FPL。Waylivra 也已於歐盟獲准上市，用來治療 FCS。

我們也與 F. Hoffman La Roche Ltd. 和 Hoffman La Roche Inc.，我們稱為 Roche，以及脊髓肌肉萎縮症基金會，或 SMA 基金會，有脊髓肌肉萎縮症，或 SMA 的合作。SMA 程式有一個已核准的產品，Evrysdi®（risdiplam），於 2020 年 8 月經美國食品藥物管理局核准，用來治療 2 個月以上兒童及成人之 SMA，於 2021 年 3 月經歐盟委員會核准，用來治療 2 個月以上患者之 5q SMA，患者經臨牀診斷為 SMA Type 1、Type 2 或 Type 3 或有 1 至 4 個 SMN2 基因拷貝。Evrysdi 也已於超過 100 個國家獲准上市，用來治療 SMA。2022 年 5 月，美國食品藥物管理局核准 Evrysdi 的標籤擴展，包含 2 個月以下嬰兒的 SMA。2023 年 8 月，歐盟委員會核准 Evrysdi 的上市許可擴展，包含 2 個月以下嬰兒在歐盟的治療。

除了我們的 SMA 程式，我們的剪接平台也包含 votoplam，正在開發中用來治療亨丁頓氏症，或 HD。我們在 2021 年 9 月宣佈，我們在健康志願者中進行的 Phase 1 研究結果顯示，votoplam 可以依劑量降低 huntingtin 消息核糖核酸及蛋白質水平，votoplam 可以在血液腦屏障中有效穿透至顯著水平，且 votoplam 被認為耐受性良好。我們在 2022 年第一季啟動了 votoplam 的 Phase 2 研究，用來治療 HD，該研究包含一個 12 週的安慰劑控制期，重點在安全性、藥物學及藥物動力學效果，隨後為一個 9 個月的安慰劑控制期，重點在 votoplam 生物標記效果。2024 年 9 月，美國食品藥物管理局授予 votoplam 程式 Fast Track 認證，用來治療 HD。2024 年 11 月，我們與 Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation，或 Novartis，簽訂了關於 votoplam 程式，或稱為 Novartis 協議，的授權與合作協議，包含相關分子。雖然 Novartis 已接管進一步發展 votoplam 程式的責任，我們仍與 Novartis 合作進行下一步。2025 年 5 月，我們宣佈 votoplam 的 Phase 2 研究達成其主要終點，即血液 HTT 降低及安全性。針對完整研究族羣的結果與先前報告的 HTT 降低、安全性良好及 12 個月 Stage 2 患者中劑量依賴性臨牀效果的早期訊號一致。此外，在治療 24 個月後，持續觀察到劑量依賴性臨牀效果改善，相對於自然史對照族羣，以及劑量依賴性 NfL 降低。2025 年第四季，與 FDA 進行了 End-of-Phase 2 會議，並達成設計全球 Phase 3 臨牀試驗的共識，預期 Novartis 將於 2026 年第一季啟動此試驗。此試驗可能作為加速批准的確認試驗，或作為註冊試驗。我們也預期在 2026 年第一季獲得 Phase 2 PIVOT-HD 延伸研究的結果，當所有參與者跨越 24 個月的時間點。

我們的發炎與鐵死亡平台由小分子化合物組成，這些化合物針對氧化還原酶，這些酶調控氧化壓力及發炎路徑，這些路徑是許多 CNS 及非 CNS 疾病病理學的關鍵。我們發炎與鐵死亡平台中最進展的分子是 vatiquinone。我們在 2023 年 5 月宣佈，針對 Friedreich's ataxia，或 FA，兒童及年輕成人進行的註冊導向 Phase 3 試驗，稱為 MOVE-FA，的初步結果。雖然試驗未達成主要終點，但 vatiquinone 治療在關鍵疾病次標的，包括站立穩定性次標的，以及其它疾病相關終點上顯示顯著效益。2024 年 10 月，我們宣佈兩個不同 FA 長期延伸試驗的預設終點已達成，顯示對疾病進展有統計學顯著的持續治療效益。2024 年 12 月，我們向美國食品藥物管理局提交了 vatiquinone 的新藥申請，用來治療患有 FA 的兒童及成人。2025 年 8 月，美國食品藥物管理局發出了關於 NDA 的完整回應信，指出 vatiquinone 未顯示足夠的療效證據，並需要進行額外的適當且控制良好的研究以支持 NDA 重提。我們在 2025 年第四季與 FDA 會面討論 vatiquinone 發展計畫。FDA 建議進行額外的研究以支持 NDA 重提。FDA 在會議記錄中指出，這項研究可以是開放標籤研究，並以自然史對照組為控制組。我們計畫在 2026 年第二季與 FDA 會面，討論這項新研究的設計。

若本公司在臨牀試驗中遭遇患者招募之延誤或困難，可能導致本公司取得必要監管核准之延誤或無法取得。

本公司面臨重大競爭，可能導致他人在本公司之前或更成功地發現、開發或商業化產品。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素及其他資訊包含於本年度報告表 10-K 中，應謹慎考量。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為較不重要，也可能影響我們的業務運作。請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 首頁，以瞭解部分受這些風險因素限制的前瞻性陳述。若上述任何風險發生，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果及未來成長前景造成重大且不利的影響。
若我們無法持續執行我們產品的商業策略，未能取得產品行銷許可的續約，或未能符合行銷許可的條件，或若我們在達成這些目標時遭遇重大延誤，將對我們的業務造成重大損害。
我們已投入大量努力與財務資源，透過研究發展、合作與併購，將產品推向市場。我們持續產生產品收入的能力，將嚴重依賴產品的成功商業化。
若我們無法成功維持我們產品的行銷許可，並取得我們產品候選藥物及已核准產品新用途的行銷許可，我們產生額外收入的能力將會
受到威脅，因而對我們的業務造成重大損害。此外，我們使授權產品在相關地區可供使用的能力建立在授權方維持行銷許可之上。我們產品的成功將取決於多項其他因素，包括以下各項：
● 我們能否及時協商、取得並維持適當的價格、保險覆蓋範圍及報銷條款，或在任何情況下取得這些條款；
